Functional Requirement: The system shall allow parents and teachers to sign up for an account using an email address and password.
The system shall allow users to log in using their email address and password.
The system shall allow users to sign in or sign up using their Google account.
The system shall require a reCAPTCHA check before Google sign-in.
The system shall allow users to reset a forgotten password through a one-time code (OTP) sent to their email, with an option to resend the code.
The system shall allow users to log out and shall restrict every page and action according to the user's role (admin, teacher, parent).
The system shall keep new accounts in Pending status until an admin approves them, and shall send an email when an account is approved.
The system shall allow the admin to view, search, create and edit user accounts.
The system shall allow the admin to approve, archive and reactivate user accounts.
The system shall allow the admin to manually mark a user's email address as verified.
The system shall allow users to view and update their own profile information and upload a profile photo.
The system shall allow the admin to manage sign-in settings, including custom Google sign-in and reCAPTCHA credentials, without displaying secret values.
The system shall require an email OTP or PIN verification before the admin can view or save integration credentials.
The system shall allow the admin to create, edit, archive and restore classes, including the class name and description.
The system shall allow the admin to assign a teacher to a class, and a teacher may lead more than one class.
The system shall automatically assign every student in a class to that class's teacher.
The system shall prevent archiving a class that still has active students.
The system shall rename the class on all related student and teacher records when a class is renamed.
The system shall allow the admin to add students and archive student records.
The system shall allow the admin and assigned teachers to view and edit student information (name, class, parent/guardian, birthdate, status).
The system shall show teachers only the students assigned to them and allow filtering the list by class.
The system shall allow viewing a student's full details together with their authorized pickup persons.
The system shall allow the admin to set and start an enrollment period.
The system shall display whether enrollment is currently open or closed.
The system shall allow parents and teachers to submit an enrollment application for a child while enrollment is open.
The system shall allow the admin to review, approve or reject enrollment applications, and approval shall create the student record.
The system shall allow the admin to view, create and update detailed student and teacher records.
The system shall allow the admin to upload, view and delete private documents attached to student and teacher records.
The system shall allow teachers to record attendance for individual students or for the whole class at once.
The system shall support the attendance statuses Present, Absent, Late, Tardy and Excused.
The system shall allow teachers to view and generate attendance reports for their classes by date range.
The system shall allow parents to view their child's attendance history and shall notify parents of attendance updates.
The system shall allow teachers to create and update academic progress entries (activity, weekly or monthly) with assessment results and teacher evaluation.
The system shall allow teachers to attach photos to progress entries, uploaded from the device or chosen from Google Drive (JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 5 MB each).
The system shall allow the admin to view and review academic progress entries.
The system shall allow parents to view their child's academic progress and photos only while the child is linked to their account.
The system shall allow the admin to create fee records for students.
The system shall allow the admin to record, correct and void cash payments and shall update the fee status (Unpaid, Partial, Paid).
The system shall generate a numbered receipt for each payment that the admin and parent can view.
The system shall keep a payment history for each fee.
The system shall allow the admin and teachers to send payment reminders to one parent or to all parents with balances, and view the email delivery summary.
The system shall allow teachers to view fee status of their students and parents to view their child's fees.
The system shall allow the admin and teachers to create, edit and delete school events with title, description, date, time and venue.
The system shall allow events to target an audience (all, teachers, or parents) and either the whole school or selected classes.
The system shall allow choosing an event venue on a map with place search.
The system shall require admin approval before a teacher's event is published, and allow events to be saved as drafts.
The system shall show each user only the published events meant for their role and classes, and shall email and notify the intended recipients.
The system shall allow the admin to connect a school Google Calendar and automatically copy published events to it, with a retry option when sync fails.
The system shall allow each user to connect a personal Google Calendar, import its events after consent, add selected school events to it, sync on request and disconnect.
The system shall allow teachers and parents to send private direct messages to each other.
The system shall allow group conversations to be created, renamed and messaged, showing the group members.
The system shall provide an inbox listing conversations and a contact search for starting new conversations.
The system shall show in-app notifications (e.g. attendance, events, fees, alerts) and allow marking them as read.
The system shall allow parents, teachers and the admin to add, edit and remove authorized pickup persons for a student.
The system shall allow teachers and the admin to verify the person collecting a pupil against the authorized pickup list before release.
The system shall allow the admin and teachers to send emergency alerts with a severity level (Low, Moderate, High, Critical) to the whole school or selected classes/students.
The system shall allow posting updates or an all-clear to an alert, and archiving, restoring or deleting alerts.
The system shall allow parents to receive and acknowledge emergency alerts.
The system shall show the email delivery summary for each alert.
The system shall generate student, fee and attendance reports for the admin.
The system shall show each role an overview dashboard with summary statistics (e.g. number of students, active students).
The system shall record important user actions and allow the admin to view the activity log.
The system shall send email notifications for account approval, password reset, events, fee reminders and emergency alerts, and record their delivery status.
